label: misaligned
reason: The formal root asserts every arbitrary function u has derivative u-prime at every t in [0,T), without any hypothesis connecting u-prime to u or guaranteeing differentiability. Take X=R, T=1, u identically zero and u-prime identically one: t=0 belongs to [0,1), but the right derivative on Ici0 is zero rather than one. A separate Lean file proves this negation using only standard axioms and without importing the erroneous root. The independent Hunter source requires the actual integrable weak derivative and asserts its agreement with the strong derivative almost everywhere. The unlinked unconditional assertion does not encode that theorem.
